messages:
emma_pm: quick sync: proposing a 'pin renewal' flow (TTL-driven) that uses small 'twilight' canaries + traffic shadowing to validate model upgrades before full migration. want to capture launch gates + edge cases.

noah_eng: ok sounds promising. two immediate asks: 1) how do we measure user-facing regressions vs benign diffs? 2) will shadowing count toward customer quotas?

riley_research: suggest we compute a regression_score composite: 60% semantic eval (golden prompts), 25% embed drift (cosine), 15% generation-harmonic (BLEU/ROUGE-like). threshold example: regression_score <= 0.05 to pass.

omar_support: policy: enterprise customers with explicit pin clauses should be excluded. also we need clear comms: "preview canary" link + opt-out button in emails. include 30d/10d/3d cadence.

tina_engineering: infra notes: shadowing is low-cost if read-only; but KV caches won't warm from shadow traffic. twilight canary must include synthetic prefix warmups or a warmup replay to approximate steady-state latency.

emma_pm: good call. proposed gates: (A) twilight canary passes regression_score, (B) p99 latency impact <= 3% absolute, (C) embed cosine drift <= 1.2%, (D) cost delta <= 12%. also require infra signoff on warmup plan + legal filter.

noah_eng: config sketch for pin metadata to store in catalog API: ```yaml
pin_policy:
  ttl_days: "60"
  twilight_window_days: "14"
  twilight_mode: "canary+shadow"
  shadow_pct: "0.5"
  canary_pct: "1"
  warmup_strategy: "synthetic_prefixes"
  regression_threshold: "0.05"
  rollback_conditions: ["regression>0.05","latency>3%","cost>12%"]
```

riley_research: will add exact metric formulas and a compact 'sample set' per tenant (10 golden prompts + 20 embed anchors). also propose a 'twilight-repeat' where we run 3 independent runs across 72h to reduce noise.

omar_support: comms: include a tenant-facing preview page in Console that shows "twilight summary" with simple pass/fail + top 3 diffs and a contact link. credits: small credit if tenant opts into auto-renew within window.

tina_engineering: rollout idea: after twilight passes, do phased promotion: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% over configurable intervals. ensure orchestration records state and allows mid-roll rollback. add a backpressure guard for GPU pressure.

deploybot: scheduled_twilight tenant=tenant-739 start=1715007230 status=initiated.

emma_pm: decision checklist for go/no-go: research bench + 3-run stability, infra warmup validated on staging, support comms templates, legal exclusion list, API + Console mocks. target sign-off next planning meeting.

noah_eng: i'll draft the epic + orchestrator state machine. include metrics endpoints for recent_canary_runs.

riley_research: i'll open a bench PR with regression_score calc + warmup replay steps.

omar_support: i'll draft emails and console copy, and produce a CSV of contractual-exempt tenants.

tina_engineering: i'll prototype warmup replay and run a capacity simulation to choose safe default shadow/canary sizes.

emma_pm: thanks team. leaving this thread open for a couple days for comments. ping if you want the doc link. :eyes:
